article.title: Artículo en expresiones institucionalizadas
article.part: Artículos, determinantes y cuantificación — Artigos, determinantes e quantificação
article.chapter: Sistema de artículos y referencia — Sistema de artigos e referência

claims.summary: The presence or absence of the article in certain frequent expressions depends on the conventional pattern of the construction and cannot be decided solely by the general meaning of the noun.

The combinations of preposition, article, and noun can be fixed by usage. For example, 'Ir à escola' contains the required preposition 'a' and the feminine definite article 'a', which fuse to form 'à'. In contrast, 'estar em casa' often omits the article when referring to one's home institutionally or habitually.
Expressions institutionalized through lexical sensitivity may select different articles. The frequency and context help establish the appropriate pattern.
